SELECT  
	CustomerAlias = NULL,
	CustomerName = NULL,
	PatientRegNo = NULL,
	PatientName = NULL,
	DocumentCode=P.PurInvCode,
	SuppInvCode=P.SuppInvCode,
	SuppInvDate=P.SuppInvDate, 
	GRN=P.GRN, 
	Type='PV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), P.PurInvCode))),
	Date = P.Date, 
	Remark = (SELECT I.NAME FROM Item I WHERE I.ICODE = D.ICode),
	Name=S.Name,
	Cash = CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' WHEN 7 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
	S.AliasName,
	Address=S.Address1,
	OpenBalance=(SELECT ISNULL(SUM(Debit-Credit), 0) FROM VirtualGL 
			WHERE	VirtualGL.AccCode=S.AccCode AND 
				VirtualGL.date < :ar_startdate),
	CheckNo=NULL,
	VRow=MAX(D.PurRowID),
	VoucherCode=P.HeaderInvNo,
	Header=P.HeaderNo,
	Qty=SUM(D.LooseQty+PackQty),
	Bonus=SUM(D.BonusQty),
	Rate=MAX(D.PurPrice),
	GrossValue=SUM((D.LooseQty + D.PackQty) * D.PurPrice),
	Discount=
		SUM((D.looseqty+D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (.01 * D.discperc)) + 
		SUM((D.looseqty+D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * P.discperc)),
	ItemPurTax=SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM(((D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
	ItemValue=SUM((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * D.PurPrice) - 
		SUM((D.looseqty + D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (.01 * D.discperc) +
				((D.looseqty + D.PackQty) * D.Purprice * (1-(.01*D.discperc)) * (.01 * P.discperc))) +  
		SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM( (D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01),
/*	MiscCharges=P.MiscCharges,
	FlatDisc=P.FlatDisc,
	InvPurTax=T.InvPurTax,
	RoundingDiff=T.RoundingDiff,*/
	NetAmt=T.NetAmt,
	Debit = CASE MAX(D.PurRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PurROWID) 
		FROM PurDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode) THEN CASE P.PurCatCode WHEN 1 THEN T.NetAmt WHEN 7 THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE MAX(D.PurRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PurROWID) 
		FROM PurDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode) THEN T.NetAmt ELSE 0 END,
	Others= CASE MAX(D.PurRowID) WHEN (SELECT MAX(PD.PurROWID) 
		FROM PurDetail PD 
		WHERE PD.PurInvCode=P.PurInvCode) THEN ISNULL(P.MiscCharges, 0) - ISNULL(P.FlatDisc, 0) + ISNULL(T.InvPurTax, 0) + ISNULL(T.RoundingDiff, 0) ELSE 0 END,
	PendingCheque=0
FROM
	(SELECT	A.AliasName, A.AccCode, A.Name, S.Address1
	FROM	Accounts A, Supplier S
	WHERE	A.AccCode IN (:ai_Suppcode) AND 
			A.AccCode = S.SuppCode) S,
	PurLedger p,	 
	PurDetail D,
	(SELECT 
		P.PurInvCode, 
		RoundingDiff=
		ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) *
				D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, 0) -
		(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) * D.unitsalestax) +
		SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01) +
			ROUND( (SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.Purprice) *
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.Discperc)) -
				P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2) + 
		SUM( ((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.Purprice) * 
				 (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + 
			P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc),
		InvPurTax=ROUND(SUM((D.PackQty + D.looseqty + D.bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
		SUM(((D.PackQty + D.looseqty) * D.Purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01), 2),
		NetAmt=ROUND(
			SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty + D.bonusqty) *
				D.unitsalestax) +
			SUM(ROUND((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * 
				(1 - (.01 * D.discperc)) * D.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
			ROUND((SUM(((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice) * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) - P.flatdisc) * (P.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0) +
			ROUND(SUM((D.looseqty + D.packqty) * D.purprice * (1 - (.01 * D.discperc))) * 
				(1- (.01 * P.discperc)) + P.misccharges + P.salestax - P.flatdisc, 0)
	FROM PurLedger P, PurDetail D
	WHERE 
		P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
		P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND
		P.SuppCode IN (:ai_Suppcode) AND
		P.date     >= :ar_startdate AND
		P.date     <= :ar_enddate
	GROUP BY
		P.PurInvCode,
		P.DiscPerc,
		P.FlatDisc,
		P.InvGSTPerc1,
		P.DiscPerc,
		P.MiscCharges,
		P.SalesTax) T
WHERE   
	P.Posted = 'Y' AND P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	P.PurInvCode = D.PurInvCode AND P.PurInvCode = T.PurInvCode AND
	P.SuppCode = S.AccCode AND
	P.SuppCode IN (:ai_Suppcode) AND
	P.date     >= :ar_startdate AND
	P.date     <= :ar_enddate
GROUP BY 
	P.PurInvCode,
	P.PurCatCode,
	P.HeaderInvNo,
	P.HeaderNo,
	D.ICode,
	P.SuppCode, 
	P.Date,
	P.DiscPerc,
	P.MiscCharges,
	P.SalesTax,
	P.FlatDisc,
	P.InvGstPerc1,
	P.SuppInvCode,
	P.SuppInvDate,
	P.GRN,
	S.AccCode,
	S.AliasName,
	S.Name,
	S.Address1,
	T.InvPurTax,
	T.NetAmt,
	T.RoundingDiff
UNION ALL
